rules: Generate in the order listed: TT-carriage-lit is made from TT-carriage with the image tool's edit mode, so everything except the light stays put.

Record each generation (file, prompt, source) in title/generation-prompts.json as before.

items.title: The carriage: Butch by the big window, the wall for the board, the end door
items.chroma: window glass and the end door's little window
items.prompt: The title screen of a game: inside a night-train carriage at night, seen exactly side-on like a theatre stage, one continuous wall from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge. Lay it out like this (fractions of the picture's width and height, measured from the top left): (1) THE BIG WINDOW on the left: one large window with rounded corners, a dark-wood frame with a thin aged-brass edge; its glass spans from 5% to 56% of the width and from 16% to 63% of the height. The glass is filled with pure green (#00FF00): flat, perfectly even, no reflections, no texture, no rain, no light on it, so the game can put a moving view behind it. Below it a narrow wooden sill at 63%-66% of the height. (2) Above the window, a brass luggage rack with netting from 3% to 58% of the width at 5%-12% of the height, an old round hatbox and a paper parcel on it. (3) THE BENCH: a long upholstered bench (deep red or dark teal, like A1-window.png) runs under the window, its seat at about 74% of the height; two high wooden seat backs make a bay: one at about 20% of the width, one at about 57%. (4) BUTCH sits on the bench in the bay, in profile, facing RIGHT along the train, looking out of the window: his body between 33% and 46% of the width, the top of his cap at about 36% of the height, his boots on the floor at about 92%. Beside him on the seat, nearer to us, the battered wooden orchard case with brass corners, his left hand resting on it; a blank paper luggage tag on a string hangs from its handle (the tag is plain, no writing). (5) THE LAMP: on a small wooden table fixed under the window just in front of him (at about 49%-54% of the width, at sill height) a small brass oil lamp is lit: the one warm amber light, a sharp-edged pool on his face, his hands, the case and the table; everything else falls off into deep shadow. (6) THE WALL: from 58% to 87% of the width and from 6% to 90% of the height, a broad, plain, dark walnut-panelled wall with NOTHING on it (no sign, no board, no picture, no lamp on it): the game hangs the departures board there. A small brass pendant lamp hangs from the ceiling above it at about 73% of the width, its shade at 2%-8% of the height, glowing dimly. (7) THE END DOOR at the right edge, from 88% to 100% of the width: a dark wooden door with a brass handle, and in it a small upright window with rounded corners from 90% to 98% of the width and 20% to 45% of the height whose glass is also pure green (#00FF00): flat, perfectly even, no reflections, no texture, no rain, no light on it, so the game can put a moving view behind it. (8) THE FLOOR: dark boards with a worn runner from 90% to 100% of the height. Pure green ONLY in the two glasses; nothing else in the picture is green. BUTCH: a lean, tired railway lost-property clerk in his fifties, about 1.75 m tall; peaked railway cap with a short black brim and a small brass badge; long deep-navy greatcoat with a row of small aged-brass buttons; dark trousers, worn boots. Same face and costume as ST5-a.png and the C-butch-poses.png sheet (the seated pose there is how he sits). FRAMING: landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Wide screens crop up to 18% off the top and the bottom, square-ish screens crop the sides, phones show only the window and Butch: keep every part exactly where the layout says. STYLE: hand-inked editorial illustration; fine dip-pen linework with delicate cross-hatching in the shadows; flat matte gouache colour fields; limited palette of ink black (#0E0C0B), deep navy (#1B2A3A), dark teal (#23413F), walnut brown (#4A3222), aged matte brass (#8A6A3C), ivory paper (#E9DFC8) and one warm amber (#E3A34E) practical light; theatrical stage-set composition with large areas of near-black negative space; one warm light source makes a sharp-edged pool of light and everything outside it falls quickly into shadow; realistic proportions and consistent scale; subtle paper grain, slightly uneven ink. No glossy highlights, no airbrushed gradients, no 3D render look, no photorealism, no anime, no text, no letters, no numbers, no signage words, no watermark. Match the style, palette, line quality and lighting of the reference image ST1-a.png exactly.
items.game_adds: the view behind both glasses (sky, hills, orchards, trackside), rain on the glass, the departures board (the menu) on the plain wall, NIGHTFALL on the glass, the lamp flicker, the carriage sway
items.zh: 标题画面的车厢：左边大窗（玻璃纯绿），Butch 坐在窗前长凳上、侧脸朝右，手放在果园箱上，小桌上点着油灯；右边是一大片空的胡桃木墙（游戏把出发牌菜单挂在这里，墙上什么都不要画）；最右是尽头门，门上小窗也是纯绿。每个东西的位置按提示里的百分比放。
